# 91. Från trader till börs-vd

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-10-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is an interview with Anders Fogelberg, a former day trader (blog 'Västkusttradern'/BB Trader) who is now CEO of Flexqube. Most of the episode covers trading in the old days: Autoliv tick spreads, opening auctions, news trading before algo firms took over. The rest is about Flexqube's shift from modular carts to robotics, its large unnamed US customer, the risk of depending on that customer, and the CEO's dislike of hype around humanoid robots. Specific stock views are few: the host notes Flexqube is one of the best-performing small caps this year, and in a sponsor read he praises Prio Nilsson for holding on to Mycronic and buying Octave.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 FLEXQ — Flexqube | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

CEO says the big US customer has validated the robot platform and robots are live at two mega-sites. Host says it is one of this year's best-performing small caps.

#### Reasoning

The view comes from the CEO, so it is biased. The large US customer and the rollout at two mega-sites validate the robotics platform. Software integration makes customers stickier than plain hardware did. CEO says investors should watch for profitability at volume, operating leverage and continued R&D. Dependence on one customer is the main risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the large US customer reduces volumes or takes the work in-house
- if profitability fails to improve as volume grows
- if R&D falls behind humanoid/robotics competitors

> *"Sen handlar det ju såklart om att se att man kan nå lönsamhet när man har viss volym."*

---

### 🟠 MYCR — Mycronic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Sponsor read: Prio Nilsson kept the position after the AI hype faded, and Mycronic hit a new all-time high.

#### Reasoning

The host praises the Prio Nilsson fund manager for holding Mycronic. This is said inside a paid sponsor segment, not as an independent view. It is momentum in hindsight, with no fresh thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if momentum after the all-time high fades
- if Prio Nilsson exits the position

> *"Då tar Mycronic en ny all-time high."*
